statement: For every dyadic DVR and unit u, both the localized and formal normal nodes xy=pi^2 u have nonzero generic C2 comparison kernel and fail degree-two polynomial surjectivity
notes: No completeness or residue-perfectness assumption; rank2 witness when ramification e>1 and prior rank6 witness when e=1. Every integer-localized K0=Z for polynomial nodes only. No source-class order or all-exponent ramified criterion is claimed.
